title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的 feed 指向同一件事：agent 正在从一个好用的工具，变成需要重新设计基础设施、团队和安全边界的工作方式。Codex CLI 的更新把长会话和企业登录补齐，Replit 把记忆与上下文当成 agent 真正干活的底座，安全团队则开始认真面对 agent swarm 和共享机器上的侧信道风险。与此同时，Thariq 离开 Anthropic，给 Claude Code 的一段阶段性告别，也提醒我们：工具会变，真正重要的是谁在持续把它推向可用。

archive.title: Agent 重构日报
archive.desc: 从 CLI 工作流、上下文记忆到网络安全，agent 正在重写软件团队的基础设施与边界。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-10-25 source feeds.

sections.title: Tools Become Workflows / 工具开始变成工作流
sections.desc: 当 agent 进入日常开发，真正重要的更新不只是模型能力，还有会话、权限和企业接入这些细节。

rewrite: Thibault Sottiaux highlights a batch of Codex CLI updates aimed at making agent work more durable: reusable prompt presets, inline model and permission settings, enterprise MCP sign-in, fixes for resuming long sessions, and Windows corporate-proxy authentication.
The signal is in the boring details. If the CLI has doubled in usage since DevDay, reliability across long sessions and corporate environments is no longer polish; it is the product.
original: On codex cli updates. We've added reusable prompt presets, inline model and permission settings, and enterprise MCP sign-in. We've also fixed failures when resuming long sessions and added Windows corporate-proxy authentication.
Surprisingly the CLI has grown 2X in usage since devday.

rewrite: Thibault Sottiaux 总结了一批让 Codex CLI 更适合长期工作的更新：可复用 prompt preset、行内模型与权限设置、企业 MCP 登录、长会话恢复修复，以及 Windows 企业代理认证。
真正值得注意的是这些看起来不花哨的细节：如果 CLI 的使用量自 DevDay 以来已经翻倍，那么长会话可靠性和企业环境兼容性就不再是 polish，而是产品本身。
original: Codex CLI 更新：加入可复用 prompt preset、行内模型和权限设置、企业 MCP 登录；修复长会话恢复失败，加入 Windows 企业代理认证。
CLI 使用量自 DevDay 以来翻了 2 倍。

rewrite: Thariq is leaving Anthropic after more than a year working on Claude Code. He says he deeply believes in Anthropic's mission and in a race to the top where responsible competition can raise the bar, but is taking a break before starting something new.
His note is also a useful snapshot of Claude Code's journey: a project that scaled far beyond what he imagined, carried by colleagues he describes as unusually talented, thoughtful, and earnest.
original: I’ve left Anthropic after more than a year of working on Claude Code and seeing it scale larger than I ever imagined.
For me, it is time for a bit of a break before diving into something new.

rewrite: Thariq 宣布离开 Anthropic。他过去一年多参与 Claude Code，亲眼看着它成长到超出想象的规模；他仍然相信 Anthropic 的使命，也相信负责任的竞争可以不断抬高行业标准，但接下来会先休息一阵。
这也是 Claude Code 这一阶段的一个侧影：产品的规模远超最初预期，而背后是一群他认为极其聪明、认真、值得信赖的同事。
original: 我离开了 Anthropic，此前一年多一直参与 Claude Code，也看着它成长到超出我想象的规模。
对我来说，是时候休息一阵，再投入下一件新事了。

sections.title: Context Is the Product / 上下文就是产品
sections.desc: Agent 要真正做事，关键不只是生成能力，而是能否持续拥有正确的记忆和工作上下文。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad says the Chroma team is joining Replit to work on one of the hardest problems in AI: giving agents the context and memory needed to do real work. He frames the team as pioneers who were building RAG before it had a name.
The strategic point is bigger than an acquisition announcement: a self-driving company needs persistent context, not just a smarter model.
original: They’re pioneers in AI. They were building RAG before it was even a thing!
At Replit, they’ll help solve one of the hardest problems in AI: giving agents the context and memory they need to do real work.

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 表示，Chroma 团队将加入 Replit，解决 AI 里最难的问题之一：给 agent 足够的上下文和记忆，让它们真的能把工作做完。这个团队很早就在做 RAG，早于这个词流行起来。
这条消息的战略含义不只是一次加入：一家想要自我驱动的公司，需要持久上下文，而不只是更聪明的模型。
original: 他们是 AI 领域的先行者，在 RAG 还没成为概念时就已经在做了。
他们会帮助 Replit 解决 AI 最难的问题之一：给 agent 提供真正干活所需的上下文和记忆。

rewrite: Aditya Agarwal points to a recurring pattern in AI and robotics: the biggest advances often come from solving many problems together instead of training narrowly specialized systems. His shorthand is simple: make the problem bigger.
It is a builder's argument for broader systems: the value may come from giving one capable system a richer environment, rather than splitting every task into a separate model.
original: Some of the biggest advances in AI have come from solving many problems together, rather than training specialized systems for individual tasks.
Make the problem bigger.

rewrite: Aditya Agarwal 提到 AI 和机器人领域一个反复出现的规律：最大的进步往往来自同时解决很多问题，而不是为每个任务训练一个狭窄的专用系统。他的概括很简单：把问题做大。
这是一种系统型 builder 视角：价值可能来自给一个足够强的系统更丰富的环境，而不是把每个任务都拆成一个独立模型。
original: AI 最大的一些进步，来自同时解决很多问题，而不是为单个任务训练专用系统。
把问题做大。

sections.title: Security at Agent Speed / Agent 速度下的安全
sections.desc: Agent 让攻击和防守都变得更有规模，云环境的隔离边界也开始面对现实检验。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie expects agent swarms for cyber defense to become one of AI's biggest categories. Agents can review code and infrastructure, test huge numbers of risk permutations, and process data at a scale human teams cannot get through quickly enough.

Security is a particularly natural fit because more compute can translate directly into more testing and more coverage. The coming shift is not one security agent, but many agents attacking the problem from different angles.
original: Agent swarms for cyber defense is about to be one of the biggest categories in AI.
Security is one of the best use-cases for swarms because it’s an obvious area where more compute in equals more value out.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，网络防御 agent swarm 很快会成为 AI 最大的应用类别之一。Agent 可以审查代码和基础设施、测试大量风险组合、处理人类团队来不及处理的数据规模。
安全是 swarm 的天然场景：投入更多 compute，就能直接换来更多测试和覆盖率。接下来可能不是一个安全 agent，而是一群 agent 从不同角度持续攻击问题。
original: 网络防御 agent swarm 很快会成为 AI 最大的类别之一。
安全是 swarm 最好的应用场景之一，因为更多 compute 能明显带来更多价值。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch describes a timing attack on shared-host VMs as an agent-era 'noisy neighbor' problem. One agent can make enough CPU-cache noise that another agent detects it by timing its own computation and cache access.

The uncomfortable conclusion is economic: the only complete fix would be dedicated hardware for every agent. Vercel Sandbox has deployed practical mitigations, monitoring, and red-teaming, but shared infrastructure now has to assume agents will actively look for theoretical weaknesses.
original: I'd describe this particular OpenAI find as a 'noisy neighbor' attack.
The only 'complete' solution would be for each agent to run on its own dedicated hardware, which obviously has significant economic consequences.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 把共享主机 VM 上的 timing attack 称为 agent 时代的「noisy neighbor」问题：一个 agent 可以制造足够的 CPU cache 噪声，让另一个 agent 通过计算和 cache 访问的时间差探测出来。
尴尬的结论是经济性的：彻底解决它，意味着每个 agent 都要用独立硬件。Vercel Sandbox 已部署现实可行的缓解措施、监控和 red-team，但共享基础设施必须开始假设 agent 会主动寻找理论上的弱点。
original: 我会把这个 OpenAI 发现称为一种 noisy neighbor attack。
唯一完整的解决方案，是让每个 agent 都运行在独立硬件上，这显然会带来重大的经济后果。

rewrite: Claude points readers to a deeper explanation of how Claude Duet handles safety, privacy, and security. The notable detail is that the product story is being presented together with its boundaries and operating safeguards, not as capability alone.
original: Here’s the deeper look at how Claude Duet handles safety, privacy, and security:

rewrite: Claude 引导读者查看 Claude Duet 如何处理 safety、privacy 和 security 的更深入说明。值得注意的是，产品叙事开始把边界和运行时防护一起讲清楚，而不只是展示能力。
original: 这里有一份更深入的说明，介绍 Claude Duet 如何处理安全、隐私和 security：

sections.title: Small Teams, Bigger Leverage / 小团队，更大杠杆
sections.desc: 当工具承担更多执行工作，团队结构本身也开始变成需要重新设计的产品。

rewrite: Dan Shipper reduces the ideal AI team to two roles: pirates and architects. The pirate side pushes into the unknown and ships; the architect side turns what works into a durable system.
It is a compact way to describe the new division of labor: speed and exploration on one side, structure and leverage on the other.
original: the best configuration of teams in AI is only two people: pirates and architects

rewrite: Dan Shipper 把理想的 AI 团队压缩成两种角色：pirates 和 architects。前者冲进未知、快速交付；后者把有效的东西变成可持续的系统。
这是对新分工的一个简洁概括：一边负责速度和探索，另一边负责结构和杠杆。
original: AI 团队最好的配置只有两种人：pirates 和 architects。
